meta.title: View-Only Mode blocks counter offers, quote edits and surrogate bids
gaps: Enable View-Only Mode from the Auction Responses Actions menu and verify that the tenant-level setting is active
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Enable View-Only Mode from the Auction Responses Actions menu and verify that the tenant-level setting is active

steps.note: Open an existing live auction event matching the setup.
Navigate to the auction Responses tab specified by the case.

args.need: enable View-Only Mode from the Auction Responses Actions menu and confirm it is active

steps.note: The catalog has no step for changing or verifying this tenant-level setting.
Check that sending a counter offer is unavailable while View-Only Mode is active.
Move to the invited vendor session to test quote editing.
Open the auction pricing bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Attempt to revise the vendor's quote and require a refusal.
Return to the buyer console for the surrogate-bid check.
Open the auction Participants list where surrogate bidding is performed.
Attempt to place a buyer-entered surrogate bid and require a refusal.
